audit.why: Riot's own text: 'Sylas steals the enemy's ultimate ability and can cast it freely.' It is a 950-range targeted cast on an enemy champion, 80/55/30s cooldown. It does not depend on the ult having been cast, so advice to 'hide your R' is wrong and actively harmful.
audit.corrected: Hijack takes Perfect Execution off you at 950 range on an 80s rank-1 cooldown. The counter is spacing and punishing the 80 seconds after he uses it, not concealment.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown-sequencing anywhere (packet defect); Abscond's dual role as entry AND exit never stated.
audit.why: Abscond (E) is 13/12/11/10/9s and is Sylas's only dash. Once he spends it to enter, he has no exit for 13 seconds at rank 1 — that is the shroud all-in window. Kingslayer (W, 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s) heals off champion damage, which is why the missingInteractions rule flags anti-heal. Akali's W Twilight Shroud makes her unselectable, so Sylas's Abduct recast (a projectile chain pull) and Hijack both need a target and both fail into the smoke.
audit.corrected: Fight when Abscond is down; shroud the moment he lands it; buy Grievous Wounds before extended trades.

edits.before: Level 6 is dangerous in a unique way: Hijack steals the last enemy ultimate used nearby, so if your team or you pop an ult in a skirmish he can literally copy it back. Play around this by not revealing your R until you're ready to commit to the kill, and keep skirmishing away from his stolen-ult range until your damage catches up.
edits.after: Level 6 is dangerous in a unique way: Hijack is a targeted 950-range steal on an 80-second cooldown, so from the moment he hits 6 he can be holding your own Perfect Execution. Play the 80 seconds after he spends it as your window — that stretch he is a Chain Lash mage with no ultimate, and a shrouded all-in has no answer.

edits.before: Sylas's Q applies a slow and his E chains into a stun combo that heals him off the damage he deals, making early trades lopsided in his favor — he can just out-sustain your poke. Levels 3-5 are his strongest window since his mana costs are low and his healing scales with missing HP. Stay out of Q-E range, farm safely, and never fight him when both Q charges are up.
edits.after: Chain Lash slows at 775 range and Kingslayer heals him off you, so long trades are lopsided — he out-sustains chip. Levels 3-5 are his strongest window. Abscond is 13s at rank 1 and it is his only dash: he cannot enter and leave on the same one, so shroud the instant he lands it and take the trade while he is stuck at your feet with nothing.
